questions.markdown: A weight of $200\ \text{kN}$ is supported by three short pillars, each $500\ \text{mm}^2$ in section. The central pillar is of steel and the outer ones are of copper. The pillars are so adjusted that at temperature of $15^\circ\text{C}$ each carries equal load. The temperature is then raised to $115^\circ\text{C}$. Estimate the stress in each pillar at $15^\circ\text{C}$ and $115^\circ\text{C}$. Take, for steel $E_s = 2 \times 10^5\ \text{N/mm}^2$ and $\alpha_s = 1.2 \times 10^{-5}/^\circ\text{C}$; for copper $E_c = 0.8 \times 10^5\ \text{N/mm}^2$ and $\alpha_c = 1.85 \times 10^{-5}/^\circ\text{C}$.

Find the radius of gyration from the horizontal centroidal axis for the channel section having $10\ \text{mm}$ thickness shown.

questions.markdown: Find the relationship between (i) Volumetric strain and Linear strain (ii) Modulus of elasticity and Bulk modulus.

A cylindrical boiler is $1.0\ \text{m}$ in diameter and $1.2\ \text{m}$ length. It is required to withstand a pressure of $1.177\ \text{N/mm}^2$. If the permissible tensile stress is $25\ \text{N/mm}^2$, permissible shear stress is $10\ \text{N/mm}^2$ and permissible change in diameter is $0.25\ \text{mm}$, find the minimum thickness of the metal required for the wall of cylinder. Take $E = 90\ \text{GPa}$, and $\mu = 0.3$.
